_comment: GOLDEN FIXTURE A2 — the SPINE-LESS dual variant (J2 uplinkTarget:'existing-core'; backtest invariant 6). Same 2-rack DUAL design as Fixture A (VLT/MC-LAG pair per rack + 4x 100G DAC ICL — a redundant pair still needs its peer-link) but the leaves uplink DIRECT to the customer's existing core: NO new spine tier, NO leaf-to-spine AOC. Proves uplinkTarget changes the hardware, not a label.
name: Fixture A2 — 60x R660/R760, 10GBase-T, 2 racks, dual, SPINE-LESS (uplink to existing core)

expected.label: leaf — 2 per rack as a pair x 2 racks (dual, unchanged from A)
NO new spine — existing-core: the leaves are the border to the core
host cabling — 120 (dual-homed, both ports across the pair)
redundant-pair ICL — 4 (the pair still needs a peer-link even spine-less)
NO leaf-to-spine AOC — no spine tier exists
OOB cabling — 60 hosts + 4 leaf switch mgmt ports (no spine) = 64
OOB inter-rack uplinks — 1 per rack x 2
inter-network transceivers — EVERY leaf pair uplinks to core (R6: 2 per pair x 2 pairs = 4, not a fixed 2 that would strand half the leaves)
inter-network patch cords — 2 per link x 4 links
